items.text: Uzi weapons now drop from hackable, elite, and underwater lab crates with ammo; spawn positions adjusted to avoid overlapping other guns, and bolt and LR weight reduced to limit dilution.
Uzi stock behavior updated: when mounted on a turret, the weapon always uses the stock's extended properties regardless of the equipped stock.
Triangular prism deployable splash damage now reaches grills and triangle hatches, with refined hatch bounds.
Combat log now records hits on gull groups.
Combat log entries use short weapon prefab names for clearer, more concise logs.
Players no longer get stuck in computer stations when the space behind the chair is blocked; extra dismount points added and a toast appears if dismount is refused.
Patrol helicopter rocket kills now correctly credit the helicopter as the attacker and display the rocket item on the death screen.
Shore ice will no longer spawn over railway tracks.
Roadside waterpipes are prevented from spawning on top of roads at T‑junctions.
Dropping items from inventory no longer unintentionally removes the held belt item.
Opening the inventory during a phone conversation no longer triggers a null reference error.
New phone conversations now display correct information after server commands.
Bunker entrance radius and fade reduced to better match monument footprint, cleaning up out‑of‑bounds paint data.
Radiation town radius and fade trimmed, smoothing blend and preventing overreach beyond intended area.
Jungle ruins monument tile and map size reduced, eliminating radius overhang and unused splat layers.
Bird flock audio now respects proper distance, making distant flocks quieter.
Scrap King building skin Steam item description corrected to “upgrade to scrap king”.
Player boats no longer leave lingering wake effects after rejoining a server; NRE crash fixed.

2026-11-03.summary:
### Weapons & Gear
- Uzi weapons now drop from hackable, elite, and underwater lab crates with ammo; spawn positions adjusted to avoid overlapping other guns, and bolt and LR weight reduced to limit dilution.
- Uzi stock behavior updated: when mounted on a turret, the weapon always uses the stock's extended properties regardless of the equipped stock.
- Triangular prism deployable splash damage now reaches grills and triangle hatches, with refined hatch bounds.

### Combat & Feedback
- Combat log now records hits on gull groups.
- Combat log entries use short weapon prefab names for clearer, more concise logs.

### Movement & Interaction
- Players no longer get stuck in computer stations when the space behind the chair is blocked; extra dismount points added and a toast appears if dismount is refused.

### Vehicles & Kill Feed
- Patrol helicopter rocket kills now correctly credit the helicopter as the attacker and display the rocket item on the death screen.

### World Generation
- Shore ice will no longer spawn over railway tracks.
- Roadside waterpipes are prevented from spawning on top of roads at T‑junctions.

### Inventory & UI
- Dropping items from inventory no longer unintentionally removes the held belt item.
- Opening the inventory during a phone conversation no longer triggers a null reference error.
- New phone conversations now display correct information after server commands.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Bunker entrance radius and fade reduced to better match monument footprint, cleaning up out‑of‑bounds paint data.
- Radiation town radius and fade trimmed, smoothing blend and preventing overreach beyond intended area.
- Jungle ruins monument tile and map size reduced, eliminating radius overhang and unused splat layers.

### Audio
- Bird flock audio now respects proper distance, making distant flocks quieter.

### UI & Items
- Scrap King building skin Steam item description corrected to “upgrade to scrap king”.

### Bug Fixes
- Player boats no longer leave lingering wake effects after rejoining a server; NRE crash fixed.

items.text: Fixed CH‑47 cargo crates getting stuck on powerline poles at the powerplant.
Reduced boat groups spawned at large oil rigs from two to one, easing traffic and spawn congestion.
PT‑boat turret aim cone widened and damage reduced, with front turret now using standard crosshair.
UZI now consumes double the condition per use, affecting its durability.

Birds and gulls receive stronger obstacle avoidance, better walking step handling, reduced startle radius, and corpses now inherit velocity; shooting distance calculations fixed and missing seagull points added.
New gliding behavior, far‑range flee response, higher circling for crows, and deep‑sea gull spawning improve wildlife dynamics.
Splash effect timing unified across buoyancy points and minimum interval lowered, preventing audio cut‑outs during storms.
Fixed null reference exception when destroying phone objects, preventing crashes.

2026-11-02.summary:
### Transport
- Fixed CH‑47 cargo crates getting stuck on powerline poles at the powerplant.
- Reduced boat groups spawned at large oil rigs from two to one, easing traffic and spawn congestion.

### Combat
- PT‑boat turret aim cone widened and damage reduced, with front turret now using standard crosshair.
- UZI now consumes double the condition per use, affecting its durability.

### AI & Wildlife
- Birds and gulls receive stronger obstacle avoidance, better walking step handling, reduced startle radius, and corpses now inherit velocity; shooting distance calculations fixed and missing seagull points added.
- New gliding behavior, far‑range flee response, higher circling for crows, and deep‑sea gull spawning improve wildlife dynamics.

### Audio & Effects
- Splash effect timing unified across buoyancy points and minimum interval lowered, preventing audio cut‑outs during storms.

### Stability
- Fixed null reference exception when destroying phone objects, preventing crashes.

items.text: Ice Lake placement rebalanced: larger ice lakes now spawn more often and anchors are used more sparsely, resulting in more varied lake distribution across new maps.
Fixed livestock getting stuck in loops or pausing when being led, especially in tight corridors or when many animals are present.
